rounds.text: The valuation carried by Sheetal Universal Ltd is difficult to support when examined alongside its severe cash generation issues, where operating cash flow plunged to Rs -13 Cr in Mar 2026 resulting in a deeply negative cash conversion of -1.08x against reported profit [E26, E27]. This alarming disconnect is compounded by free cash flow sinking to Rs -14 Cr alongside operating cash flow reaching only -50% of operating profit [E28, E29], while borrowings escalated sharply from Rs 22 Cr to Rs 38 Cr over the same annual period [E31]. Furthermore, the stock trades at a demanding P/E of 28.8x to 29.72x and a price-to-book ratio of 6.07x to 6.25x, both sitting well above sector benchmarks of 23.02x and 4.37x respectively [E1, E2, E6, E7]. Operating margin trends are explicitly flagged as inconsistent over the last two years and two quarters [E24, E25], pointing to unstable core profitability despite recent margin expansions [E22, E23]. Market expectations have also run aggressively ahead of underlying business delivery, with price growth exceeding profit growth by 98% [E47] while the stock sits extended at 100% of the way up its 52-week range and 0.0% away from its 52-week high [E38, E39, E55]. conceded: [E12], [E15], [E19]
